notes: Hard: author a single-source O(n) spatial-binned particle update (counting/COM binning then O(1) per-particle motion with a live scalar recurrence), compile it into serial and genuinely OpenMP builds, and ship a two-mode driver whose report is cross-checked by re-running the binaries. The verifier inspects the OpenMP binary for GOMP_parallel/libgomp (an unthreaded or stub binary fails inspection), demands bit-identical HASH/MOVE across builds, positive MOVE on MOTION=1 scenarios (genuine motion), a 16*N-byte positions file, and schema-exact result.json across hidden scenarios including a degenerate N=4 case.
